marta: quick heads upwe're doing a kernel pack rebuild (q4a + q8-lite) in the quiet window tonight at 02:10 UTC. touching scheduler slotting and quant packing. low change set but touching hot paths. want ops eyes and a clear rollback plan.

deploybot: scheduled: kernel-pack-rebuild-2025 | start=2025-01-08T02:10:00Z | expected-duration=00:40 | runbook=/eng-runtime/playbooks/kernel-pack-rebuild.md :gear:

ivy: copy that. what are the exact abort conditions?

marta: abort if p95 latency increases >18% sustained 4m, if native OOMs >=1 host in 2m, or if eval drift >4% on the quickset. also abort for any crash-loop or binary signature mismatch.

opsbot: preflight status: signature ok, checksum ok, reserve 6% capacity present, telemetry hook connected. smoke-id: smoke-20250108-0130. :white_check_mark:

tj: pin strategy? if we need to revert do we sticky old bundle or route to non-quant?

raja: ops preference: route to non-quant fallback pool first (fastest), then sticky-pin the last stable bundle for investigation. pin TTL 2h by default.

marta: agreed. runbook steps: 1) deploybot abort + immediate route to fallback pool, 2) pin previous bundle with ttl=2h, 3) open incident and start triage, 4) if root cause found and fix available we schedule hotpatch.

ivy: can we add an automatic eval run right after canary starts? want before/after diffs on long-context prompts.

marta: yes - harness will run: `./harness/night_eval --suite=long-dialog --baseline=engine:stable-20250105 --candidate=engine:kernel-pack-20250108` and post result to thread.

opsbot: canary targets: us-west-2 (1% traffic) and eu-west-1 (0.5%). ramp plan: 1% -> 8% after 20m -> 30% after 50m -> full in 3h if green. auto-pause on alert.

tj: i'll lower pager thresholds and watch first 30m. post eval thresholds here once set.

raja: i'll enable verbose stderr capture for the first 15m on canaries to catch OOM stacks.

marta: release notes blurb: "Kernel pack rebuild: improved quant packing and scheduler slotting for lower tail latency on medium/long sequences. Fallback to non-quant engine available." jamie will publish RN.

ivy: thanks i'll join for preflight at 01:50 UTC.

marta: perfect. i'll paste preflight logs and eval diff 01:55 UTC. :rocket:
